entries.title: Borrowed ledger rows
entries.root_cause: The ledger keeps a slice of rows live while pushing to the same vector. End the slice borrow before mutation.

entries.title: Borrowed beacon entry
entries.root_cause: The beacon module retains a map value reference while inserting into that map. Copy the needed value or release the reference before insertion.
entries.differs_from_earlier: The same borrow-check error concerns a different collection and module and requires a separate fix.

entries.title: Index benchmark job timeout
entries.root_cause: The index benchmark processes a corpus too large for its job time limit. Reduce its workload or adjust that job limit.

entries.title: Replay fixture readiness timeout
entries.root_cause: The replay fixture never passes its health check because the configured endpoint is wrong. Correct the service health endpoint.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Both jobs exceed their time limit, but replay waits on an incorrect service health endpoint instead of running an oversized benchmark.
